name: cash-tax
description: Warns before an idle session's prompt cache expires and the next message re-reads the whole conversation at full price, with the token count and cost. /keepwarm pings the cache to keep it alive.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last request. Claude Code on a subscription uses 60; API-key sessions often 5.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before expiry
warnMinutes.description: When the band above the prompt appears.

writePerMTok.title: Cache write price, $ per million tokens
writePerMTok.description: What a cold reload costs. Claude Opus 5.5 with a 1-hour cache: 8 (2x the $4 input price).

readPerMTok.title: Cache read price, $ per million tokens
readPerMTok.description: What a warm message or a keep-warm ping costs. Claude Opus 5.5: 0.20.

minTokens.title: Ignore conversations smaller than this many tokens
minTokens.description: Below this a cold reload is cheap enough not to mention.

confirmCold.title: Hold the first message after expiry for confirmation
confirmCold.description: On: the first message after the cache expired is put back in the box with the cost; press Enter again to send it.

maxPings.title: Keep-warm stops after this many pings
maxPings.description: So /keepwarm never runs all night unnoticed.
